articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用快速扫描隧道显微镜，实时解析了电子晶体中介观Y结缺陷的内部和整体动力学。研究直接追踪了毫秒时间尺度上的单个电子重排，并绘制了局域化的电报噪声图，揭示了集体序参量动力学与微观电荷运动之间的直接联系。该动力学被建模为局域库仑关联、非局域构型约束以及束缚于缺陷的混合振幅-相位集体模式相互作用的结果。
authors: Yevhenii Vaskivskyi, Jaka Vodeb, Igor Vaskivskyi, Dragan Mihailovic

articles.title: Attractive statistical forces and Pauli crystal formation in trapped Fermi gases
articles.title_zh: 囚禁费米气体中的吸引统计力与泡利晶体形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.12043v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Exchange statistics endows identical particles with an effective "statistical potential", whose familiar exact form is two-body and purely repulsive for fermions. Here we construct an exact collective many-body form: the thermodynamics of N trapped ideal fermions maps onto classical distinguishable particles governed by a single potential -- exactly for harmonic confinement at all temperatures, and to leading semiclassical order for arbitrary potentials. The associated force separates canonically into pairwise contributions, which for N≥ 3 can turn attractive, governed by a simple geometric criterion. Classical minimization reproduces observed few-body Pauli-crystal symmetries and agrees with the N=55 ground-state probability maximum at sub-percent shell accuracy. Heating drives discrete structural transitions accompanied by a crossover of the strongest force from attractive to repulsive. Both the potential and its forces are directly computable from existing single-shot imaging data, turning quantum exchange into measurable classical mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个精确的集体多体形式，将N个囚禁理想费米子的热力学映射到由单一势能支配的经典可区分粒子。研究发现，对于N≥3的情况，相关的力可以转变为吸引力，并由一个简单的几何判据控制。经典最小化重现了观察到的少体泡利晶体对称性，并与N=55基态概率最大值在亚百分比壳层精度上吻合。加热会驱动离散的结构转变，伴随着最强力从吸引到排斥的交叉。
authors: Kawon Lee, Sangeun Oh, Young Woo Choi, Jeong-Hyuck Park

articles.title: Berry-Curvature Activation by Orbital Flux in a Kagome Altermagnet
articles.title_zh: Kagome交错磁体中轨道磁通激活贝里曲率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04984v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate topological electronic responses in a kagome altermagnetic metal hosting a compensated coplanar 120ⁱ̧rc magnetic texture. Using a minimal tight-binding model containing nearest-neighbor hopping, noncollinear exchange coupling, intrinsic spin--orbit coupling, and a time-reversal-odd loop-current order, we disentangle the magnetic, orbital, and relativistic mechanisms governing the electronic response. The exchange field produces pronounced momentum-dependent spin splitting and spin-polarized Fermi surfaces without generating a net magnetization. Nevertheless, in the absence of loop-current order, a hidden antiunitary symmetry TC₂z enforces vanishing Berry curvature and intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity, even for finite spin--orbit coupling. A directed imaginary bond order breaks this protection and activates finite Berry curvature and a sizable, strongly filling-dependent Hall response already in the nonrelativistic limit. Spin--orbit coupling subsequently reconstructs the avoided crossings and redistributes the Berry curvature, enhancing or suppressing the Hall response depending on filling. For sufficiently strong loop-current order and spin--orbit coupling, a global gap opens at nₑ₌₃, and the Hall conductivity approaches 2e²/h, consistent with an occupied-band Chern number of magnitude two. Parameter-space and filling-dependent calculations further demonstrate that the Hall-active regime extends over broad ranges of exchange coupling, spin--orbit coupling, and chemical potential and remains robust against symmetry-preserving longer-range hopping. These results identify orbital-current order as an independent route for converting a Hall-silent kagome altermagnet into an anomalous Hall metal or a gapped topological phase without net magnetization, noncoplanar spin order, or scalar spin chirality.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了Kagome交错磁性金属中的拓扑电子响应，该金属具有补偿的共面120度磁结构。研究利用一个最小紧束缚模型，揭示了磁性、轨道和相对论机制如何共同影响电子响应。结果表明，在没有环电流序的情况下，一个隐藏的反幺正对称性强制贝里曲率为零。定向虚键序打破了这种保护，并在非相对论极限下激活了有限的贝里曲率和显著的、强填充依赖的霍尔响应。
authors: Meysam Bagheri Tagani, Carmine Autieri

articles.title: Disorder-Induced Entanglement Phase Transitions in Non-Hermitian Systems with Skin Effects
articles.title_zh: 无序诱导的非厄米系统皮肤效应中的纠缠相变
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2186 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-08-07-2186 Non-Hermitian dynamics is ubiquitous in various physical systems. While recent study shows that such a dynamics leads to an area-law scaling of the entanglement entropy due to the non-Hermitian skin effects, it remains unclear how disorder changes the behavior of the entanglement entropy in a non-Hermitian system with skin effects. Here we study the dynamics of a many-body state of free fermions in the paradigmatic Hatano-Nelson model with open boundaries, and find that the area-law behavior of the entanglement entropy in the pristine Hatano-Nelson model develops into a logarithmic scaling for small disorder strength. As we further increase the disorder strength, the system reenters an area-law regime through an entanglement phase transition. At the critical point, the entanglement entropy exhibits a universal algebraic scaling. We further demonstrate the absence of a conformal invariance in the log-law regime by examining the subsystem entanglement entropy, the connected correlation function and the mutual information. Finally, we show the existence of disorder induced entanglement phase transitions in the Hatano-Nelson model with periodic boundaries.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有皮肤效应的非厄米系统中无序如何改变纠缠熵的行为。研究发现，在Hatano-Nelson模型中，纠缠熵的面积定律行为在小无序强度下演变为对数标度。随着无序强度增加，系统通过纠缠相变重新进入面积定律区域，并在临界点表现出普适的代数标度。该工作还揭示了对数定律区域中共形不变性的缺失。
authors: Kai Li, Ze-Chuan Liu, and Yong Xu

articles.title: Characterization of state complexity in adaptive quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 自适应量子电路中态复杂度的表征
articles.abstract: npj Quantum Information, Published online: 07 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41534-026-01326-8 Characterization of state complexity in adaptive quantum circuits
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了自适应量子电路中量子态复杂度的表征问题。该研究旨在深入理解量子计算中量子态的结构和性质，这对于设计和优化未来的量子算法及硬件至关重要。具体内容需查阅原文以获取详细的理论和实验结果。
authors: Guoding Liu
Junjie Chen
Xiongfeng Ma

articles.title: Experimental Quantum Voting Using Photonic Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger States
articles.title_zh: 利用光子格林伯格-霍恩-蔡林格态的实验量子投票
articles.abstract: Author(s): F. Joseph Marcellino, Mingsong Wu, and Rob Thew Two research teams have run small-scale demonstrations of voting protocols that could ensure election security using the principles of quantum mechanics. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 060802] Published Fri Aug 07, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了一项利用光子格林伯格-霍恩-蔡林格（GHZ）态进行量子投票的实验。该研究展示了一种基于量子力学原理的投票协议，旨在提高选举的安全性。这项小规模的演示为未来更安全、更可靠的投票系统提供了潜在的解决方案。
authors: F. Joseph Marcellino, Mingsong Wu, and Rob Thew

articles.title: Experimental Quantum Electronic Voting
articles.title_zh: 实验量子电子投票

articles.title: Promise of Graph Sparsification and Decomposition for Noise Reduction in QAOA: Analysis for Trapped-Ion Compilations
articles.title_zh: 图稀疏化和分解在QAOA降噪中的前景：对囚禁离子编译的分析
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2185 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-08-07-2185 We develop new approximate compilation schemes that significantly reduce the expense of compiling the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) for solving the Max-Cut problem. Our main focus is on compilation with trapped-ion simulators using Pauli-X operations and all-to-all Ising Hamiltonian H_Ising evolution generated by Molmer-Sorensen or optical dipole force interactions, though some of our results also apply to standard gate-based compilations. Our results are based on principles of graph sparsification and decomposition; the former reduces the number of edges in a graph while maintaining its cut structure, while the latter breaks a weighted graph into a small number of unweighted graphs. Though these techniques have been used as heuristics in various hybrid quantum algorithms, there have been no guarantees on their performance, to the best of our knowledge. This work provides the first provable guarantees using sparsification and decomposition to improve quantum noise resilience and reduce quantum circuit complexity. For quantum hardware that uses edge-by-edge QAOA compilations, sparsification leads to a direct reduction in circuit complexity. For trapped-ion quantum simulators implementing all-to-all HIₛᵢₙg pulses, we show that for a (1-ϵ) factor loss in the Max-Cut approximation (ϵ gt 0), our compilations improve the (worst-case) number of HIₛᵢₙg pulses from O(n²⁾ to O(nłog(n/ϵ)) and the (worst-case) number of Pauli-X bit flips from O(n²⁾ to Ołeft(fracnłog(n/ϵ)ϵ²i̊ght) for n-node graphs. This is an asymptotic improvement for any constant ϵ gt 0. We demonstrate that significant improvements to the approximation ratio are obtained using decomposition in simulated trapped-ion experiments with dephasing noise. We further present a generic argument showing that sparsification results in an exponentially improved circuit fidelity lower bound in digital computing schemes based on one- and two-qubit gates, which are relevant to a wide variety of hardwares such as superconducting qubits and certain neutral atom or trapped ion setups, and more sophisticated noise models. We anticipate these approximate compilation techniques will be useful tools in a variety of future quantum computing experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了新的近似编译方案，显著降低了解决Max-Cut问题的量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的编译成本。研究主要关注使用囚禁离子模拟器进行编译，并基于图稀疏化和分解原理。该工作首次提供了利用稀疏化和分解来提高量子噪声韧性并降低量子电路复杂度的可证明保证，对于边缘逐边QAOA编译的量子硬件尤其有效。

articles.title: Quantum random number generation from the continuous variable payload for the SPOQC mission
articles.title_zh: 基于SPOQC任务连续变量载荷的量子随机数生成
articles.abstract: The necessity of random numbers for various tasks, from simulation to cryptography, is crucial and immense. Here we demonstrate CV-QRNG using the CV payload of the SPOQC mission. The homodyne setup for QRNG uses the laser from the payload, in addition to potentially being used as detector in the case of an uplink scenario. Here we quantify the extractable secure randomness from the QRNG setup, that involves homodyne measurement of the vacuum states. The extracted randomness is tested against NIST test suite in addition to formally upper bounding the min-entropy. With the raw key length being Mb in a given satellite pass, we get a total length of Kb of certified random numbers from the 12-bit ADC.
articles.abstract_zh: 随机数在模拟和密码学等多种任务中至关重要。本文展示了利用SPOQC任务的连续变量（CV）载荷进行CV量子随机数生成（QRNG）。该QRNG设置通过零差测量真空态来量化可提取的安全随机性，并使用NIST测试套件对提取的随机性进行了测试。结果表明，在给定的卫星通过中，原始密钥长度达到Mb，从12位ADC中获得了总长度为Kb的认证随机数。
authors: Vinod N Rao, Killian Murphy, Fadi Ahwal, Emma Tien Hwai Medlock, Timothy P Spiller and Rupesh Kumar

articles.title: Sequential sharing of ‘local’ entanglement under robust projective measurements
articles.title_zh: 在鲁棒投影测量下“局域”纠缠的序贯共享
articles.abstract: While previous studies on sequential quantum sharing rely on either sharp measurements for ‘non-local’ entangled states or weak measurements for ‘local’ entangled states, we bridge this gap by investigating ‘local’ entangled states under a robust projective measurement framework. We demonstrate that probabilistic projective measurements with fixed probability can enable entanglement sharing for certain ‘local’ entangled states. Furthermore, we show that by probabilistic combination of certain different projective measurement strategies, the entanglement sharing can be expanded even under strict probability constraints. Subsequently, we prove that under projective measurements with deterministic probabilities, the maximum number of observers capable of sharing entanglement for ‘local’ entangled states is explicitly derived in terms of the entanglement of the initial state. Finally, the relationship among the sharing capacity, the initial state’s entanglement and the measurement strength of projective measurements is analytically presented.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有关于序贯量子共享的研究主要依赖于对“非局域”纠缠态的精确测量或对“局域”纠缠态的弱测量。本文通过在鲁棒投影测量框架下研究“局域”纠缠态，弥补了这一空白。研究表明，具有固定概率的概率性投影测量可以实现某些“局域”纠缠态的纠缠共享，并且通过概率性组合不同的投影测量策略，可以扩展纠缠共享。此外，文章还推导了在确定性概率投影测量下，能够共享“局域”纠缠态的最大观察者数量，并分析了共享能力、初始态纠缠和投影测量强度之间的关系。
authors: Yue Zhong, Duanfeng Liu, Shao-Ming Fei and Bang-Hai Wang

articles.title: Squeezing-fueled quantum Otto engine via measurement-induced cooling: the two-qubit quantum Rabi model
articles.title_zh: 通过测量诱导冷却的挤压驱动量子奥托引擎：双量子比特量子拉比模型
articles.abstract: We investigate a quantum Otto engine (QOE) constructed from the two-qubit quantum Rabi model, operating within a cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) architecture. The engine operates with two qubits as the working substance and a single non-Markovian hot thermal bath, modeled via the hierarchical equations of motion formalism. In place of a conventional cold thermal reservoir, the cooling stroke is realized through a projective measurement protocol on the cavity mode, which acts as an ancillary subsystem and effectively mimics a cold bath for the qubit working medium via measurement back-action. A squeezing drive applied to the cavity mode serves as a quantum fuel. We demonstrate that cavity squeezing systematically enhances both the power output and operational efficiency of the engine—the work extracted per unit of heat drawn from the hot bath-driving it above the standard quantum Otto limit. In the limit-cycle regime, the efficiency, while remaining above the Otto bound throughout, asymptotically converges to it from above. This identifies squeezing as a controllable quantum resource for thermodynamic optimization. Our results reveal that the interplay between qubit–cavity coupling, measurement-induced cooling, and non-equilibrium squeezing gives rise to a multi-resource thermodynamic architecture with performance characteristics inaccessible to conventional two-bath QOEs, thereby providing a concrete route toward experimentally realizable quantum heat engines in cavity QED platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个基于双量子比特量子拉比模型构建的量子奥托引擎（QOE），其在腔量子电动力学（QED）架构中运行。该引擎以两个量子比特作为工作物质，并利用腔模上的投影测量协议实现冷却冲程，有效模拟了冷浴。研究表明，施加到腔模的挤压驱动作为量子燃料，系统地提高了引擎的功率输出和运行效率，使其超越了标准量子奥托极限。在极限循环状态下，效率始终高于奥托界限，并从上方渐近收敛。这表明挤压是一种可控的量子资源，可用于热力学优化。
authors: S R Rathnakaran and Asoka Biswas

articles.title: Mechanical squeezed-Fock gravimeter
articles.title_zh: 机械挤压-福克引力仪
articles.abstract: Levitated mechanical systems are promising candidates for quantum gravimetry, as gravity couples directly to their center-of-mass motion, enabling the large mass of a mesoscopic particle to serve as a sensing resource. In this paper, we propose a mechanical squeezed-Fock qubit gravimeter using a Duffing oscillator that is driven by a detuned two-phonon pump. In the squeezed-Fock basis, the gravitational force couples to the anti-squeezed quadrature, which enhances the gravity-induced transition rate while preserving the direct mass scaling of the mechanical force coupling. We show that sensitivity improves with reduced effective qubit splitting that is controlled by the squeezing parameter and the Duffing nonlinearity. We further analyze mechanical damping and show that squeezing converts ordinary dissipation into anisotropic qubit noise, setting a practical trade-off between signal amplification and decoherence rate. These results identify the mechanical squeezed-Fock qubit as a new platform for quantum-enhanced gravimetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 悬浮机械系统是量子引力测量领域的有前景候选者。本文提出了一种利用由失谐双声子泵浦驱动的杜芬振子构建的机械挤压-福克量子比特引力仪。在挤压-福克基中，引力耦合到反挤压正交分量，从而增强了引力诱导的跃迁速率。研究表明，灵敏度随着由挤压参数和杜芬非线性控制的有效量子比特分裂的减小而提高。此外，挤压将普通耗散转化为各向异性量子比特噪声，在信号放大和退相干速率之间建立了实际的权衡。这些结果表明机械挤压-福克量子比特是量子增强引力测量的新平台。
authors: Rozhin Yousefjani and Saif Al-Kuwari

articles.title: Local Uniqueness of the Born Rule on Categories with Complex-Weighted Morphisms
articles.title_zh: 具有复数加权态射范畴上玻恩定则的局域唯一性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: I prove a local uniqueness theorem for the Born rule in the setting of small categories equipped with complex morphism weights and path-amplitude probability functionals. Given (i) non-negativity, (ii) polynomiality of bounded total degree, (iii) global U(1) invariance, (iv) classical-limit additivity over mutually exclusive paths, and (v) normalization, I show that the probability assignment P: C -> R>=0 is uniquely determined to be P(z) = |z|². The notion of mutually exclusive paths is given a precise categorical formulation as the absence of a shared factorization through any common morphism. I relate the result to reconstructions of quantum probability due to Gleason, Hardy, and Chiribella-D'Ariano-Perinotti, and identify the extension to global coherence under morphism composition as an open problem connected to synthetic probability theory in Markov categories. The Born rule emerges as the unique locally consistent probability law on complex amplitudes, fixed solely by phase invariance and classical-limit behavior, independent of any Hilbert-space framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在配备复数态射权重和路径-振幅概率泛函的小范畴背景下，玻恩定则的局域唯一性定理。在满足非负性、有界总度多项式性、全局U(1)不变性、互斥路径上的经典极限可加性和归一化等条件下，作者证明了概率赋值P(z)唯一确定为P(z) = |z|²。该结果将玻恩定则确立为复振幅上唯一的局域一致概率定律，仅由相位不变性和经典极限行为决定，独立于任何希尔伯特空间框架。
authors: Tayfun Ustun

articles.title: Cluster-State Witnesses of Finite-Speed Hidden Influences
articles.title_zh: 有限速度隐性影响的簇态判据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05271v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bell experiments rule out local common-cause explanations of quantum correlations, yet they do not exclude hidden influences that travel faster than light while still having a finite speed in a preferred frame. Multipartite spacetime arrangements turn this possibility into a constraint: two late parties that are outside each other's hidden-influence cones must remain Bell-local once the earlier events are fixed. Here, we formulate this constraint as a projected-polytope separation problem for cluster-state correlations, using only marginal data containing at most one late party. From linear cluster states, we construct a four-qubit witness with the bound S₄łe 6 and quantum value 4+2sqrt2, and a five-qubit witness with S₅łe 10 and quantum value 6+4sqrt2. We certify that the exposed faces are facets of the corresponding projected hidden-influence polytopes. These results identify linear-cluster graph states as certifiable and experimentally friendly resources for finite-speed hidden-influence tests.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝尔实验排除了量子关联的局域共同原因解释，但并未排除在优选参考系中以有限超光速传播的隐性影响。本文将多体时空排列中的这一可能性转化为一个约束，并将其表述为簇态关联的投影多胞形分离问题。研究从线性簇态构建了四量子比特和五量子比特的判据，并证明了其暴露面是相应投影隐性影响多胞形的刻面。这些结果表明线性簇图态是可认证且实验友好的资源，可用于有限速度隐性影响的测试。
authors: Weikang Li, Mengyao Hu, Dong-Ling Deng, Valerio Scarani

articles.title: Relative entropy of entanglement of Haar random states
articles.title_zh: 哈尔随机态的纠缠相对熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We determine the relative entropy of entanglement of a bipartite mixed state h̊oAB obtained by tracing out one subsystem of a tripartite Haar-random pure state |ψångleABC, finding E_R(h̊oAB)=łogfracd_Ad_Bmax(d_A,d_B,d_C)+O(1). Equivalently, the relative entropy of entanglement nearly saturates the smaller of the entanglement of formation E_F(h̊oAB) and the mutual information I(A:B). The upper bound is achieved by an explicit separable state obtained through one-sided Schmidt dephasing, which is therefore approximately closest.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文确定了通过对三体哈尔随机纯态|ψ⟩ABC的一个子系统进行部分迹操作所获得的二体混合态ρAB的纠缠相对熵。研究发现，该纠缠相对熵近似饱和了纠缠形成度E_F(ρAB)和互信息I(A:B)中的较小值。通过单边施密特退相干获得的一个显式可分离态实现了该上界，因此该可分离态近似为最接近的态。
authors: Takato Mori, Beni Yoshida

articles.title: Scalable Circuit Cutting: A Framework for Combined Gate and Wire Cuts Using Gate Groups
articles.title_zh: 可扩展电路切割：结合门组的门和线切割框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05287v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum circuit cutting enables the execution of large circuits on devices with a limited number of qubits by partitioning circuits into independent subcircuits. However, this introduces a sampling overhead, which grows exponentially with the number of cuts, rendering the choice of cut placements critical for practical circuit cutting. Determining optimal cut placements remains computationally challenging, particularly as circuits grow in size. Additionally, existing circuit cutting approaches typically treat gate and wire cuts independently. Those combining both cutting approaches, however, do not take advantage of joint cutting, i.e., identifying common gate groups and cutting them jointly for a reduced overhead. This work presents a unified framework that combines gate and wire cutting within a single partitioning strategy, enabling more efficient circuit decompositions. Moreover, our approach incorporates joint cutting via a novel gate grouping technique, further reducing sampling overhead. By formulating the cut placement problem as a scalable graph partitioning task, our method efficiently identifies near-optimal cut placements for large circuits, also providing diagnostic feedback on whether circuits are suitable for cutting.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子电路切割通过将电路划分为独立的子电路，使得在有限量子比特设备上执行大型电路成为可能，但会引入随切割数量呈指数增长的采样开销。本文提出了一个统一的框架，将门切割和线切割结合在单一分区策略中，从而实现更高效的电路分解。此外，该方法通过一种新颖的门分组技术引入了联合切割，进一步减少了采样开销。通过将切割放置问题表述为可扩展的图分区任务，该方法能够有效地识别接近最优的切割放置。
authors: Fiona Jiali Fröhler, Yannick Stade, Christian Ufrecht, Daniel D. Scherer, Robert Wille

articles.title: Quantum channel learning with limited parallel access
articles.title_zh: 有限并行访问下的量子信道学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05307v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum channels can characterized by their action on an orthogonal operator basis, where these operators are related to observable properties of the quantum system. For qudit and multimode bosonic systems, this is encoded respectively in the Heisenberg--Weyl transfer matrix estimated from the Choi state, and in the characteristic-function transfer function estimated from the Choi state generated by probing with a two-mode squeezed vacuum state. We derive sample-complexity bounds for estimating entries of these transfer matrix/function to additive accuracy ϵ with success probability ≥1-δ, under different resources: access to the complex-conjugate channel E^* and/or simultaneous access to c copies of the channel. In all settings, the learner uses parallel channel calls with adaptively chosen, ancilla-assisted input states and measurements. Absolute values of transfer-matrix entries can be learned efficiently with simultaneous access to E and E^*, with tight scaling ϵ⁻⁴. Without conjugate access, any c
articles.abstract_zh: 量子信道可以通过其在正交算子基上的作用来表征。本文推导了在不同资源（例如，访问复共轭信道E*和/或同时访问c个信道副本）下，以加性精度ϵ和成功概率≥1-δ估计这些转移矩阵/函数条目的样本复杂度界限。在所有设置中，学习者都使用并行信道调用，并采用自适应选择的、辅助量子比特辅助的输入态和测量。研究表明，在同时访问E和E*的情况下，转移矩阵条目的绝对值可以高效学习，具有紧密的ϵ⁻⁴缩放。
authors: Mahadevan Subramanian, Hyukgun Kwon, Liang Jiang

articles.title: Unidirectional Dark-to-Bright Rescue in Cavity-Coupled Quantum Transport
articles.title_zh: 腔耦合量子传输中的单向暗态到亮态救援
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05312v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong light-matter coupling in optical microcavities can transport energy ballistically across an emitter array, but the same coupling buries most of the excitation in a manifold of dark states that grows with system size and traps energy outside the transport channel. We show that the off-diagonal (non-Condon) part of the exciton-phonon coupling opens a one-way escape route from this trap, driving population irreversibly from dark states into the radiative channel. This rate is fixed by a photonic-weight conservation law rather than by dark-bright overlap which evacuates the dark manifold at a rate independent of system size. The mechanism contributes to transport with near-complete efficiency with four signatures being single exponential dark state decay, a size scaling efficiency gap, distinct temperature behavior, and a resonance in the escape rate at vibrational bath modes. Beyond polariton transport, it recasts dark states from a parasitic loss channel into an engineered dissipative resource, with implications for light harvesting and dissipation based quantum control.
articles.abstract_zh: 光学微腔中的强光-物质耦合可以将能量弹道式地传输穿过发射器阵列，但这种耦合也将大部分激发埋藏在随系统尺寸增长的暗态流形中，将能量困在传输通道之外。本文研究表明，激子-声子耦合的非对角（非康登）部分为从该陷阱中逃逸开辟了一条单向路径，将布居数不可逆地从暗态驱动到辐射通道。该机制以接近完全的效率促进传输，其特征包括单指数暗态衰减、尺寸缩放效率差距、独特的温度行为以及在振动浴模处的逃逸速率共振。
authors: Jack Diab, Arpit Arora, Taylor L. Patti, Prineha Narang

articles.title: The Hidden Subgroup Problem in Semidirect Products and Quasi-Hamiltonian Groups
articles.title_zh: 半直积和准哈密顿群中的隐藏子群问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Several early quantum algorithms, including Simon's algorithm and Shor's period-finding are instances of the hidden subgroup problem (HSP) over finite abelian groups. No polynomial-time quantum algorithm is known for the HSP over arbitrary non-abelian finite groups. The non-Abelian case is of particular interest because some instances, such as the dihedral and symmetric group HSPs, are connected to lattice problems and graph isomorphism, respectively. In this work, we give polynomial-time quantum algorithms for two further families containing non-Abelian groups. First, we consider groups of the form G=At̊imesǎᵣₚₕᵢ Zₚ^ₖ, with A finite Abelian, p prime, kin N and the action of mathbb Zₚ^ₖ is generated by the scalar automorphism amapstoμ a, for some μinmathbb ZøₚₑᵣₐₜₒᵣₙₐₘₑEₓₚ₍A₎^×, where Exp(A) is the exponent of A. Our algorithm is efficient when A has bounded generator rank and Exp(A)/p=polylog(|G|). This includes the case A=Z_N for NinN and k=1, studied by Bacon, Childs and van Dam (FOCS 2005), and A=Zq^ᵣ with q prime and rin N studied by van Dam and Dey (TQC 2014). Second, we give a polynomial-time quantum algorithm for finite quasi-Hamiltonian groups under a mild assumption on the input structure. Quasi-Hamiltonian groups are finite nilpotent groups with modular subgroup lattice, or equivalently the finite groups in which every subgroup is permutable. As far as we know, this is the first quantum algorithm to exploit the modularity of the subgroup lattice for solving the HSP. This extends, under the aforementioned structured input assumption, the quantum algorithm for Dedekind groups given by Hallgren, Russell, and Ta-Shma (SIAM J. Comput. 32, 2003).
articles.abstract_zh: 西蒙算法和Shor周期查找等早期量子算法是有限阿贝尔群上隐藏子群问题（HSP）的实例。对于任意非阿贝尔有限群上的HSP，目前尚无多项式时间量子算法。本文为包含非阿贝尔群的两个家族提供了多项式时间量子算法。首先，研究考虑了G=A⋊Zₚ^ₖ形式的群，其中A是有限阿贝尔群。其次，文章为有限准哈密顿群提供了一个多项式时间量子算法。
authors: Mauro E. S. Morales

articles.title: QBism on Locality and Nonlocality
articles.title_zh: 关于局域性和非局域性的QBism观点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently Pienaar (2026), building on work of Cavalcanti (2021), has shown that QBism cannot always assume distinct observers' quantum-measurement outcomes---say, of Wigner and his friend---are embedded in a single spacetime. This follows from QBism's rejection of the `Absoluteness of Observed Events' assumption in the Bong et al. no-go theorem. Thus, QBism has no choice but to treat the notion of spacetime every bit as personalistic as it treats quantum states and quantum measurement outcomes. In a way, this is not a surprise to QBists, as they have taken the notion of `personalist spacetimes' to be the ansatz most compatible with their other views since at least 2009. But it does enjoin us to finally make crystal clear the sense in which QBism is a purely local interpretation of quantum mechanics despite this new theorem and despite quantum theory's age-old violation of Bell's inequalities. With the extra clarity we also hope to poise QBism for a distinctly new way to approach issues at the interface of quantum theory and gravity.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明，QBism不能总是假设不同观察者的量子测量结果嵌入在单一时空中。这源于QBism拒绝了Bong等人不可行定理中的“观测事件的绝对性”假设。因此，QBism必须像对待量子态和量子测量结果一样，以个人主义的方式对待时空概念。本文旨在阐明QBism作为量子力学纯粹局域解释的意义，尽管有新的定理和量子理论对贝尔不等式的长期违反。这种清晰性有望为QBism提供一种独特的新方法来处理量子理论和引力交叉领域的问题。
authors: John B. DeBrota, Christopher A. Fuchs, Rüdiger Schack

articles.title: Maximally entangled states are not complete for pseudo-telepathy
articles.title_zh: 最大纠缠态对于伪心灵感应并非完备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05378v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One of the longstanding open problems in quantum nonlocality is to determine if maximally entangled states are complete for bipartite pseudo-telepathic games: namely, if every nonlocal game which admits a perfect entangled strategy admits such a strategy which uses a maximally entangled state. We exhibit a counterexample to this in the form of a bipartite nonlocal game with input sets of size 4 and 3 and output sets both of size 6. This game is part of a new class of nonlocal games, which we call inner product games, which could be of independent interest.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子非局域性中一个长期存在的开放问题是，最大纠缠态是否对双边伪心灵感应博弈是完备的。本文通过一个输入集大小为4和3、输出集大小均为6的双边非局域博弈，提出了一个反例。该博弈属于一类新的非局域博弈，即内积博弈，其本身可能具有独立的兴趣。
authors: Olivier Lalonde

articles.title: Quantum Error Mitigation with Diffusion-Like Models
articles.title_zh: 基于扩散类模型的量子误差缓解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coupling between a quantum system and its environment causes decoherence by transferring information from the system to environmental degrees of freedom. When discretized in time, such interactions can be interpreted as sequences of weak measurements that provide an effective model of noisy quantum dynamics. Motivated by this picture, we propose an AI-assisted error-mitigation framework for quantum diffusion processes generated by sequential local weak measurements. The forward process progressively erases information from the input state through weak measurements performed in randomly selected Pauli bases, producing basis-dependent local dephasing and locally depolarizing dynamics on average. Machine-learning models are trained on exact synthetic density matrices to learn a channel- and distribution-specific denoising map and estimate the corresponding pre-noise state. We benchmark the approach on single-qubit states and separable and entangled multi-qubit registers. We also study distribution-dependent local-to-global reconstruction, in which local reduced density matrices are used to reconstruct the global state. This experimentally motivated setting relies on locally accessible information and is therefore compatible with noisy and distributed quantum systems. More broadly, the framework provides a hybrid classical-quantum approach for approximating non-unitary dynamics and mitigating coherence loss.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子系统与环境的耦合会导致退相干，本文受此启发，提出了一种AI辅助的误差缓解框架，用于由序列局部弱测量产生的量子扩散过程。该框架通过在随机选择的泡利基中进行弱测量来逐步擦除输入态的信息，并训练机器学习模型以学习去噪映射并估计预噪声状态。研究在单量子比特态以及可分离和纠缠的多量子比特寄存器上对该方法进行了基准测试，并探讨了基于局部约化密度矩阵的全局态重构。
authors: Yuval Idan, Ofek Nourian, Elad Mentovich, Taylor L. Patti, Eliahu Cohen

articles.title: Feasibility-Preserving Quantum Search for Constrained Transportation Routing
articles.title_zh: 约束运输路径规划中的可行性保持量子搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transportation routing problems such as the Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) and the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) are characterized by strict feasibility requirements involving customer assignment and visit rules, route sequencing, and depot-return logic alongside cost minimization. Most quantum routing formulations adopt Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) encodings, where feasibility is incorporated indirectly via penalty terms in the cost Hamiltonian. While convenient for standard implementations of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), QUBO encodings allow the quantum search dynamics to allocate substantial probability to infeasible route configurations. This study develops a transportation-grounded constraint-aware Quantum Alternating Operator Ansatz (QAOA+) framework that embeds feasibility-preserving logic directly into the search operator. We introduce a custom mixer that functions as a quantum analogue of feasibility-preserving routing neighborhoods, using column-wise swap moves, it restricts evolution to feasible configurations while enabling structured exploration of valid routes. We compare three constraint-handling architectures: penalty-based QUBO QAOA, penalty free QAOA+ with the feasibility-preserving mixer, and a Hybrid QAOA+ combining mixer based feasibility with and penalty guidance. Results on small TSP and VRP instances show that constraint-handling architecture strongly influences feasible-route sampling, convergence behavior, and probability concentration over low-cost feasible routes. These findings position constraint-aware quantum search as a methodological extension of transportation routing search approaches, where feasibility is enforced through admissible quantum transitions rather than post-hoc penalties.
articles.abstract_zh: 运输路径规划问题（如TSP和VRP）具有严格的可行性要求，而大多数量子路由公式通过惩罚项间接处理可行性，可能导致量子搜索偏向不可行配置。本研究开发了一种基于运输的约束感知量子交替算子Ansatz (QAOA+) 框架，将可行性保持逻辑直接嵌入到搜索算子中。该框架引入了一个定制的混合器，通过列交换操作将演化限制在可行配置中，同时实现对有效路径的结构化探索。
authors: Dahye Kim, Monika Filipovska

articles.title: Interferometric Quantum Polynomial Chaos Expansion as a Generative Model for Calorimeter Shower Simulation
articles.title_zh: 作为量能器簇射模拟生成模型的干涉量子多项式混沌展开
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the quantum polynomial chaos expansion, a generative algorithm in which a single circuit is the entire model, and we use it to learn calorimeter images. In a classical chaos expansion the randomness is the input and the coefficients are fitted. Here the randomness is still the only input, entering the circuit as rotation angles and re-uploaded at every block, so that each measured observable is a chaos expansion of the latent variables whose order equals the circuit depth, and what is fitted are the gate angles themselves. Expressivity therefore grows with depth rather than with classical coefficients, correlations between outputs arise only from entangling gates, and a single latent wire read by all qubits carries the collective mode of the data. Nothing fitted stands between the circuit and the sample, so switching the entanglers off is a setting of the model itself and provably yields independent outputs, and attribution of the learned correlations to individual gates becomes a measurement. Choosing between two measurement bases shot by shot sharpens attribution into certification, and the trained model violates the Bell bound obeyed by every classical generative model with local response, whatever its size. We train the model on Geant4 shower data, execute the identical circuit on a superconducting processor with its accuracy loss predicted in advance, prove a no-go theorem for the tail dependence of every smooth generator read out through expectation values, and identify the circuit primitive that removes this limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种量子多项式混沌展开作为生成算法，其中单个电路即为整个模型，用于学习量能器图像。与经典混沌展开不同，这里的随机性作为旋转角度输入电路并在每个块中重新上传，使得每个测量到的可观测值都是潜在变量的混沌展开。模型的表达能力随深度增长，输出之间的关联仅来源于纠缠门，并且训练后的模型能够违反贝尔不等式。
authors: Jamal Slim, Saverio Monaco, Florian Rehm, Dirk Kruecker, Frank Gaede, Kerstin Borras

articles.title: Experimental demonstration of the Quantum Fourier Transform on up to 100 qubits using a convolutional compilation strategy
articles.title_zh: 使用卷积编译策略在多达100个量子比特上实验演示量子傅里叶变换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05435v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present and experimentally validate the `Convolutional QFT': a constructive compilation strategy for the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) subroutine on a linear nearest neighbor (LNN) qubit topology. We first introduce a novel strategy that compiles the n-qubit QFT onto an LNN topology using only n² - n CX gates, matching requirements of a direct compilation on an all-to-all architecture. We then derive the convolutional variant used in our experiments, which requires an additional two CX gates in total, and is realized via a compact, translation-invariant kernel circuit gadget that traverses a quantum register. We demonstrate the power of the convolutional compilation strategy on the IBM Quantum Platform by executing QFT benchmarking circuits. We measure a process fidelity of 11.4% at 50 qubits, and 1.8% at 80 qubits. The correct output state remains clearly distinguishable above background noise up to 100 qubits. These results constitute the largest experimental QFT demonstrated on any quantum computing hardware to date.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并实验验证了一种名为“卷积QFT”的量子傅里叶变换（QFT）子程序编译策略，适用于线性最近邻（LNN）量子比特拓扑。该策略能以高效的CX门数量将n量子比特QFT编译到LNN拓扑上，并通过紧凑的、平移不变的核电路实现。研究在IBM量子平台上执行QFT基准测试电路，在50个量子比特时测得11.4%的进程保真度，在80个量子比特时为1.8%，并且在高达100个量子比特时仍能清晰区分正确输出态。这些结果代表了迄今为止在任何量子计算硬件上演示的最大规模实验QFT。
authors: Paul Coote, Michael J. Biercuk, Yuval Baum

articles.title: What meter interference can tell us about the statistics of weak measurements
articles.title_zh: 测量仪干涉能揭示弱测量的统计信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05494v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is widely assumed that the quantum fluctuations of the meter readout in a weak measurement make it impossible to identify the contributions originating from the individual values of the physical property observed in the measurement. Here, we show that a careful analysis of the quantum dynamics of the meter system allows us to identify a universal relation between quantum interference in the post-selection probability, and quantum interference in the statistics of the meter readout. The analysis reveals that quantum interference modifies the readout distribution of the meter in two ways, a diffusion term that identifies the appropriate operator ordering in the post-selected variance of the observed system property, and a wavefunction-dependent update of the initial meter statistics based on the effect of back action on the post-selection probability. Our results show that the statistical patterns described by meter interference provide important details about the physics of post-selection in weak measurements, allowing us to exclude the possibility of statistical artefacts in the experimental observation of weak values.
articles.abstract_zh: 弱测量中测量仪读数的量子涨落通常被认为无法识别物理属性个体值的贡献。本文展示了通过仔细分析测量仪系统的量子动力学，可以识别后选择概率中的量子干涉与测量仪读数统计中的量子干涉之间的普遍关系。分析表明，量子干涉以两种方式修改测量仪的读数分布，并提供了关于弱测量中后选择物理学的重要细节，从而排除了实验观察弱值中统计伪影的可能性。
authors: Holger F. Hofmann, Tomonori Matsushita, Masayoshi Isobe, Jonte R. Hance

articles.title: Generating two-mechanical mode entangled cat states, and steady-state entanglement, in cavity optomechanics in the presence of dissipation
articles.title_zh: 在耗散存在下腔光力学中生成双机械模式纠缠猫态和稳态纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05503v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate a dissipation-engineering approach to produce a phase-dependent collective-mode Schrödinger cat state involving two modes. Our model features a single cavity mode that interacts with two spectrally identical mechanical oscillators. Both oscillators are coupled through a phase-dependent hopping interaction. We demonstrate that by adjusting the phase of the phonon-hopping interaction, one can control the bipartite entanglement of the phase-dependent two-mode cat state during its generation. Additionally, our study reveals that phonon interactions act as a tunable parameter, enabling the manipulation of steady-state entanglement between the bare mechanical modes, even in the presence of environmental effects and thermal excitations. Our scheme provides a feasible approach for the phase-dependent multi mode non-Gaussian states preparation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种耗散工程方法，用于在腔光力学系统中生成涉及两个模式的相位依赖集体模式薛定谔猫态。该模型通过单个腔模式与两个频谱相同的机械振子相互作用，并通过相位依赖的声子跳跃相互作用耦合。研究表明，调整声子跳跃相互作用的相位可以控制双模猫态生成过程中的双边纠缠，并且声子相互作用可作为可调参数来操纵裸机械模式之间的稳态纠缠。
authors: Sanket Das, Jason Twamley

articles.title: How Much Reconstruction Does Quantum Machine Learning Need? Late Fusion of Independently Trained Quantum Subcircuits
articles.title_zh: 量子机器学习需要多少重构？独立训练量子子电路的后期融合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05595v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Circuit cutting lets a large quantum neural network (QNN) run as independent subcircuits on small devices, but rebuilding its outputs by reconstruction carries a classical sampling overhead exponential in the number of cuts - the dominant runtime cost in prior work. We ask whether, for machine-learning tasks, this step is necessary, and replace it with late fusion: each subcircuit is trained and measured independently, and a small classical head combines their outputs - a linear-cost, decision-level combination borrowed from multimodal learning. To characterize the trade-off we introduce a quantumness dial Q, a tunable reconstruction budget interpolating from pure fusion to full reconstruction, and a cut-entanglement diagnostic that indicates how much reconstruction a task needs (Spearman h̊o=0.59 over 104 runs). Across synthetic and standard datasets, independently trained late fusion matches full reconstruction accuracy within 0.04 at every point of the controlled sweep and on every classical benchmark, at exponentially lower cost; it is also markedly more robust to shot and device noise. Controlled entangled-data experiments locate the boundary where fusion must fail. We do not claim advantage over classical machine learning - consistent with recent benchmarking, quantum offers no accuracy edge on these datasets. Late fusion is thus an efficient, noise-robust, self-characterizing alternative to reconstruction for circuit-cutting QML.
articles.abstract_zh: 电路切割允许大型量子神经网络在小型设备上作为独立子电路运行，但其输出的重构会带来指数级的经典采样开销。本文提出用后期融合替代重构，即每个子电路独立训练和测量，然后由一个小型经典头部结合它们的输出，从而显著降低成本。研究引入了一个“量子性拨盘Q”来表征这种权衡，并在合成和标准数据集上验证了独立训练的后期融合在指数级更低的成本下，其准确性与完全重构相匹配，并且对噪声更具鲁棒性。
authors: Prabhjot Singh, Adel N. Toosi, Rajkumar Buyya

articles.title: Beyond transversality: structure of Clifford circuits for CSS codes
articles.title_zh: 超越横向性：CSS码Clifford电路的结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05688v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We characterize four groups of Clifford circuits for Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) codes that are relevant to fault-tolerant logical operations. First, we show that every code-preserving Clifford circuit is a product of Z-diagonal circuits, composed of S and CZ gates, and their X-basis analogues. Second, we define the two-fold transversal group, generated by depth-one two-local code-preserving circuits, and show that each of its elements can be expressed as a product of layers consisting of either Z-diagonal, X-diagonal, or CNOT gates. As a corollary, every transversal gate is a product of three transversal diagonal circuits; for connected non-self-dual codes, two such circuits suffice. We further show that every code-preserving automorphism circuit, consisting of single-qubit Clifford gates and permutations, has a normal form comprising a Hadamard layer, a permutation, and two diagonal circuits. We also define a two-fold automorphism group, in which a depth-one two-local circuit may be code-preserving up to a permutation, and show that its logical image can be larger than that of the two-fold transversal group. For 136 CSS codes, we provide explicit generators and determine the logical image of the two-fold transversal group. We find 78 codes whose full logical Clifford group is generated by two-fold-transversal circuits, including codes of distances 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, and 12, with respective rates 2/5, 3/4, 1/9, 1/5, 2/5, and 3/56. We construct three families of CSS codes from bipartite grids, cut-complements, and quadrics, many of which realize the full logical Clifford group in this way. More generally, the induced logical group can be large even when it is not full logical Clifford group: it has order at least 460,800 for the gross code and roughly 10²⁶ for a clustered-cyclic code.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文刻画了四组与容错逻辑操作相关的Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) 码的Clifford电路。研究表明，每个保码Clifford电路都是Z对角电路及其X基对应物的乘积。此外，每个横向门都是三个横向对角电路的乘积，并且每个保码自同构电路都具有包含Hadamard层、置换和两个对角电路的范式。
authors: Victor V. Albert

articles.title: Finite Quantum Histories: Holonomy Spectra, Minimal Clocks, and Exact Clock-Change Covariance
articles.title_zh: 有限量子历史：完整谱、最小时钟和精确时钟变化协方差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05748v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We solve cyclic finite-dimensional quantum histories for arbitrary time-dependent unitary steps, without assuming that one step has finite order. The propagation Hamiltonian is a unitary connection Laplacian on a cycle; its complete gauge invariant is the monodromy M=UL₋₁ḑots U₀. Its spectrum is łambdaₐ,ₖ=1-o̧s((2π k-θₐ₎/L), where eⁱθₐinspec(M). Thus the exact history sector is isomorphic to Fix(M), while frustration, the gap above a nonempty zero-energy sector, the determinant, and the finite-temperature trace are obtained in closed form. Ordinary spectral data recover the multiset of monodromy phase cosines but not phase orientation; low energy certifies proximity to an exact relational history. We then define the predictive quotient of a sharp finite clock relative to an accessible operator system as the unique coarsest event alphabet preserving all conditional statistics on a history sector. A finite-error theorem shows that threshold clustering recovers this quotient when the minimum diamond separation of inequivalent event channels exceeds four times the estimation error, and proves an optimal record-count bound. With full matrix access and homogeneous step U, the minimal number of clock events is the projective order of U. We distinguish the normalizer of the clock algebra from transformations preserving the coherent history code and classify oriented exact sharp clock changes by U(r)×Z_L on a rank-r history sector; without orientation the cyclic factor becomes dihedral. Reversible changes of full-information clock fibers are necessarily unitary, so irreversible coarse-graining is not exact clock covariance. Minimal realizations of a complete history Gram kernel are uniquely unitarily equivalent, with a finite-data Procrustes bound. Independent finite-matrix code verifies the main results.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文解决了任意时间依赖酉步骤的循环有限维量子历史问题，并推导了其传播哈密顿量的完整规范不变量——单值性M的谱。研究表明，精确历史扇区与Fix(M)同构，并以封闭形式获得了挫折、非空零能量扇区上方的间隙、行列式和有限温度迹。此外，本文定义了锐利有限时钟相对于可访问算子系统的预测商，并提出了一个有限误差定理，证明了在特定条件下阈值聚类可以恢复该商。
authors: Maxim V. Churilov

articles.title: The Locality Gap: A Thermodynamic Law for Objective Facts
articles.title_zh: 局域性间隙：客观事实的热力学定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Objective facts in quantum Darwinism are values recorded redundantly in many independently accessible fragments of the environment. Redundancy does not create additional logical information, so its thermodynamic meaning has remained unclear. We show that it creates an exact work asymmetry between controllers with different access architectures. For a record cloud F and a partition P into blocks that cannot be jointly controlled, the reversible isothermal erasure penalty relative to a global controller is kBT times the partition total correlation. If the source event X is supplied as catalytic classical side information, subtracting the corresponding penalty gives the source-loss law FPT=kBTłeft[sumBᵢₙPI(X:F_B)-I(X:F)i̊ght]. We call this the thermodynamic factuality charge. It ranges from -kBT H(X) for perfect secret sharing to (|P|-1)kBT H(X) for perfect broadcast objectivity. Its normalized form defines a thermodynamic record number between 0 and |P|. We derive Landauer--Darwin bounds, endpoint-rigidity certificates, exact growth and partition-refinement laws, spectrum-broadcast saturation, and closed formulas for noisy classical and quantum collision models. The theory does not modify quantum mechanics or posit objective collapse; it identifies the thermodynamic resource generated by redundant records under restricted control.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子达尔文主义中的客观事实是环境中许多独立可访问片段冗余记录的值，其热力学意义尚不明确。本文证明这种冗余在具有不同访问架构的控制器之间产生了精确的功不对称性。研究定义了热力学事实性电荷，并推导了朗道-达尔文界限、端点刚性证书、精确增长和分区细化定律，以及噪声经典和量子系统中的封闭公式。
authors: Maxim V. Churilov

articles.title: Multi-cavity strong coupling to an electron spin ensemble: spectral and dark-state signatures
articles.title_zh: 多腔与电子自旋系综的强耦合：谱学和暗态特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin ensembles are considered as potential candidates for quantum memory and quantum enhanced sensing applications. Here, we explore the controlled coupling of multiple superconducting microwave cavities to a spin ensemble, which shows signatures of strong coupling and, due to the multi-mode character, the formation of dark states. In particular, the latter are of interest, as they provide a potential pathway to enhance memory times and enable protected storage of non-classical states in spin ensembles due to the suppressed coupling to the circuit environment. We model the spin multi-cavity hybrid to reproduce the spectra and extract characteristic coupling strengths using the input-output formalism.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋系综被认为是量子存储和量子增强传感的潜在候选者。本文探讨了多个超导微波腔与自旋系综的受控耦合，该系统表现出强耦合特征以及多模特性导致的暗态形成。暗态因其能增强存储时间并保护非经典态而备受关注。研究通过输入-输出形式主义对自旋多腔混合系统进行建模，以重现其光谱并提取特征耦合强度。
authors: P. Oehrl, B. Pérez González, A. Dunaev, M. Althammer, T. S. Parvini, F. Piazza, M. Benito, H. Huebl

articles.title: QSCI-CMP: Quantum-Selected Configuration Interaction with Chemically Motivated Preselection
articles.title_zh: QSCI-CMP：基于化学动机预选的量子选择组态相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present QSCI-CMP, a quantum-classical hybrid algorithm for molecular ground-state calculations that reduces both the query count and the gate count of sample-based quantum diagonalization with amplitude amplification (SQD-AA). SQD-AA mitigates the measurement bottleneck of quantum-selected configuration interaction (QSCI) by amplifying the basis states that have not yet been measured. Its oracle, however, specifies the measured states by listing them one by one, so its gate count grows with the number of collected states. Moreover, the quantum resources are spent even on states whose importance is evident from chemical knowledge, such as low-order excitations from the Hartree-Fock reference, which could be collected classically at the outset. We therefore propose to fix such chemically trivial states in advance, include them in the diagonalization subspace from the start, and exclude them from the amplification target, using a low-cost oracle that recognizes them through the excitation level and the seniority number of each basis state. We numerically demonstrate that QSCI-CMP reduces the query count and the gate count required to reach chemical accuracy by up to approximately 68% and 72% relative to SQD-AA for 24-qubit systems. The chemically trivial subspace is freely tunable within the classical computational budget. A larger subspace shifts more work onto the classical solver and increases the reduction in quantum cost, and when it captures the ground state sufficiently well, no quantum sampling is needed at all. We also point out that a query-optimal iteration count known from the analysis of quantum search further reduces the query count of both methods by approximately 12%.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了QSCI-CMP，一种用于分子基态计算的量子-经典混合算法。该算法通过预先固定化学上显而易见的态，并将其排除在振幅放大目标之外，从而减少了基于采样的量子对角化与振幅放大（SQD-AA）所需的查询次数和门计数。数值结果表明，QSCI-CMP能有效降低计算成本。
authors: Masahiko Kamoshita, Kosuke Mitarai

articles.title: Robust logarithmic lower bound on shared-resource cost for f-routing
articles.title_zh: f-路由共享资源成本的鲁棒对数下界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In one-round f-routing, Alice receives an n-bit string and an unknown qubit, while Bob receives another n-bit string. They exchange one simultaneous message each, and the value of f determines which party must recover the qubit. Message lengths, local systems, and local operations are unrestricted. We charge only Edᵢₘ(h̊oLR)=łog₂min{øperatornamerankh̊o_L,øperatornamerankh̊o_R}, the logarithm of the smaller marginal support dimension of the shared state prepared before the inputs arrive. The state may be arbitrary and mixed. For the inner product modulo 2, we prove that every protocol with worst-case error at most 0.09 in both routing cases, measured in the full, unhalved diamond norm, satisfies dłog₂₍₂d)=Ømega(n) for d=min{øperatornamerankh̊o_L,øperatornamerankh̊o_R}. Thus d=Ømega(n/łog n) and Edᵢₘ(h̊oLR)gełog₂ n-łog₂łog₂ n-O(1). The closest earlier growing Schmidt-rank lower bound for an explicit routing function assumes zero error in one routing case. Our proof converts correctness into a matrix whose entries have a constant gap between the two routing cases. It approximates this matrix by one whose rank depends on d, but not on the dimensions of messages or local systems. A sign-rank lower bound for the matrix of the inner product modulo 2 completes the argument. A lower bound polynomial in n on Edᵢₘ remains open.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了单轮f-路由问题中共享资源的成本。作者证明了对于内积模2的情况，任何在两种路由情况下最坏误差不超过0.09的协议，其共享态的较小边际支持维度的对数满足一个鲁棒的对数下界。这一结果改进了先前对显式路由函数的施密特秩下界，该下界通常假设其中一种路由情况的误差为零。
authors: Kevin Bogner

articles.title: Time-Dependent Hamiltonian Simulation with Optimal Query Complexity
articles.title_zh: 具有最优查询复杂度的含时哈密顿量模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06094v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give a query-optimal algorithm for simulating a general n-qubit time-dependent Hamiltonian H(t) on [0,T], assuming that H is Lipschitz continuous and |H(t)|łeqα. In the standard mathrmHAMmbox-T access model, the algorithm approximates the time-ordered propagator U_H(T) to error ǎrepsilon using  Ołeft( α T+fracłog(1/ǎrepsilon) łog(e+łog(1/ǎrepsilon)/(α T)) i̊ght)  mathrmHAMmbox-T queries. This matches the known query lower bound for time-independent Hamiltonians, showing that time dependence incurs no asymptotic query overhead. Our method first constructs a one-query transducer that, given an auxiliary state, implements an approximation to U_H(T) and returns the state unchanged. A weighted combination of circuits that apply the transducer different numbers of times makes the error caused by omitting this state decay factorially, yielding the stated optimal precision dependence. For time-independent Hamiltonians, the same method also gives a query-optimal alternative to qubitization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于模拟一般n量子比特含时哈密顿量H(t)的查询最优算法。该算法在标准HAM-T访问模型下，以最优的查询复杂度近似时间排序传播子U_H(T)。研究表明，时间依赖性不会带来渐近的查询开销，并且该方法对于不含时哈密顿量也提供了一种查询最优的替代方案。
authors: Boyang Chen, Minbo Gao, Xinzhao Wang, Shuo Zhou

articles.title: Master equation for systems interacting with linearized gravity
articles.title_zh: 与线性化引力相互作用系统的主方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06121v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the open quantum dynamics of a system of two masses interacting with an environment of linearized gravitational waves. We formulate the analysis in terms of the observable proper distance between the two masses, and show that the canonical variables obtained from the standard Lagrangian, expressed in terms of the Fermi normal coordinates, are not suitable for an effective description of the system. We resolve this issue through a unitary transformation that provides a physically meaningful system--environment decomposition and derive the master equation to leading order in G. Its dissipative sector reproduces the classical energy loss due to gravitational-wave emission, while the noisy contributions suppress coherences between states with different mass quadrupole, or effectively, different proper separations. In the regime where the proper distance can be described by considering small quantum fluctuations around an average distance l₀, the dynamics reduces to a Caldeira--Leggett-type equation, with a decoherence rate dependent on the baseline length l₀.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了两个质量系统与线性化引力波环境相互作用的开放量子动力学。作者通过幺正变换解决了标准正则变量不适用于有效描述系统的问题，并推导出了引力常数G领先阶的主方程。该方程的耗散部分再现了引力波辐射引起的经典能量损失，而噪声贡献则抑制了具有不同质量四极矩态之间的相干性。
authors: Oliviero Angeli, Anirudh Gundhi, Angelo Bassi

articles.title: Quantum Amplitude Estimation for Travel Time Estimation in Stochastic Vehicle Routing Problems
articles.title_zh: 随机车辆路径问题中行程时间估计的量子振幅估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06145v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solving the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) in Stochastic Transportation Networks (STNs), a core task in Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), introduces estimation challenges for stochastic path travel times and the resulting VRP objective function. These challenges have typically been addressed through computationally expensive sampling-based techniques such as Monte Carlo simulation, whose performance depends on sample size, the sampling strategy, and the underlying travel time distributions. To address these issues, this study proposes and validates a quantum computing technique, Quantum Amplitude Estimation (QAE) for path-level travel time estimation in STNs. Without relying on sampling or prior assumptions of the travel time distribution, the proposed framework encodes all feasible travel time realizations into a quantum superposition, enabling a theoretical quadratic speed-up over Monte Carlo simulation. Four QAE variants are implemented in IBM's Qiskit framework, namely Canonical AE (CAE), Iterative AE (IAE), Maximum Likelihood AE (MLAE), and Faster AE (FAE), together with four rotation-angle scaling strategies for handling different discrete travel time distributions. Experiments on a small-scale STN show that the choice of scaling method and rotation-angle range significantly affects estimation accuracy, while the four QAE variants produce comparable estimates across all tested conditions, with IAE exhibiting the most stable overall performance. The results provide practical guidance on parameter selection for future hybrid quantum-classical optimization frameworks in ITS applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出并验证了一种量子计算技术——量子振幅估计（QAE），用于随机交通网络（STNs）中路径级行程时间的估计。该方法无需采样或预设行程时间分布，将所有可行的行程时间实现编码为量子叠加态，从而在理论上实现了相对于蒙特卡洛模拟的二次加速。研究在IBM Qiskit框架中实现了四种QAE变体，并结合了四种旋转角度缩放策略。
authors: Xingyue Wang, Monika Filipovska

articles.title: Error-detected surgery on Iceberg codes
articles.title_zh: 冰山码上的错误检测手术
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06187v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct explicit error-detecting surgery gadgets---small systems of auxiliary qubits and checks---for the high-rate Iceberg codes [[2N,2N-2,2]], to perform fault-detected measurements of logical Pauli products. The construction follows the perspective of surgery as the gauging of a logical operator, regarded as a symmetry of the code. We give a complete classification of logical Pauli operators under the permutation automorphism group of the Iceberg code, reducing the construction to one gadget per orbit, and we verify with circuit-level simulations that the gadgets are fault-detecting, with the expected post-selected logical error rate. The gadgets require reconfigurable long-range connectivity, available on platforms such as neutral-atom arrays, making an error-detected demonstration of Pauli-based computation a natural near-term experiment. The paper doubles as a self-contained introduction to gauging and code surgery, developed alongside a simple worked example.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为高码率冰山码[[2N,2N-2,2]]构建了显式的错误检测手术小工具，用于执行逻辑泡利乘积的故障检测测量。这些小工具通过将逻辑算子视为代码的对称性进行规范化来实现，并在电路级模拟中验证了其故障检测能力。该技术需要可重构的长程连接性，使其成为中性原子阵列等平台上的一个自然近期实验。
authors: Andrea Di Fini, Samuel Crew, Laura Pecorari, Guido Pupillo

articles.title: Quantum fluctuation relations in first-detection processes
articles.title_zh: 首次探测过程中的量子涨落关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive two quantum fluctuation relations for systems undergoing repeated projective measurements. These fluctuation relations characterize the work that can be extracted from a quantum device when a first-detection event triggers a mechanical operation leading to positive work production. The correction to the standard quantum Jarzynski equality depends logarithmically on the mean first-detection time for the time-reversed dynamics. Application of Jensen's inequality leads to fundamental limits on both the total work involved in the repeated measurements and final mechanical operation, and the extracted work alone. The general case of a device connected to an external environment is also considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了系统在重复投影测量下经历的两个量子涨落关系。这些关系描述了当首次探测事件触发机械操作并产生正功时，可以从量子设备中提取的功。研究表明，对标准量子Jarzynski等式的修正与时间反演动力学的平均首次探测时间呈对数关系。
authors: A. Imparato

articles.title: Global vs. Product Observables in Bipartite Quantum Systems: The Sharp Bound
articles.title_zh: 双分量子系统中的全局可观测量与乘积可观测量：精确界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06235v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To probe a bipartite quantum system, one may use arbitrary global operators or restrict to product operators acting separately on the two subsystems. We determine the sharp universal comparison between the resulting norms. For every zin Mₙøtimes Mₘ, we prove |z|₁łeqsqrt2minn,m|z|_ǎrepsilon, where |ḑot|₁ is the trace norm and |ḑot|_ǎrepsilon is the injective tensor norm associated with the trace norms on Mₙ and Mₘ. To prove the upper bound, we establish an L₁ noncommutative Khintchine inequality whose random coefficients are the entries of a Haar unitary. We also show that the coefficient sqrt2 is sharp. As applications, we show that the same sharp constant governs the gap between bipartite correlation measured in trace norm and that measured by a correlation function, and obtain an improved universal upper bound for quantum data hiding. The upper bound has also been formalized and machine-checked in Lean.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文确定了双分量子系统中全局算子和乘积算子所产生的范数之间的精确普适比较。研究证明了对于任意z，其迹范数|z|₁与内射张量范数|z|_ε之间存在一个以sqrt2为系数的精确上界。该结果还应用于双分关联的测量以及量子数据隐藏的普适上界。
authors: Zhi Li, Xiaofei Shi

articles.title: Exponential logical-error reduction in quantum memories via optimal syndrome-measurement timing
articles.title_zh: 通过最优综合征测量时序实现量子存储器中逻辑错误的指数级减少
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06242v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Syndrome-measurements timing is usually treated as a fixed clock cycle of a quantum error-correcting code. For quantum memories, however, the intra-measurement interval is itself an optimizable control parameter: measuring too rarely allows idling errors to accumulate, whereas measuring too often introduces measurement-induced faults. We propose a phenomenological logical-noise model for this trade-off and analytically show that the optimal syndrome-measurements interval scales inversely proportionally with the code distance and that this produces an exponential reduction of logical-error rates in the distance relative to constant-interval schedules. Furthermore, for time-dependent idling noise, we develop an adaptive timing strategy based on the measured syndrome activity that outperforms every fixed-interval protocol, with largest gains for short but strong noise bursts. Simulations of rotated surface-code memories with matching decoding validate the phenomenological model, the distance-dependent optimum, and the adaptive-strategy improvement. Moreover, with the experimental noise parameters reported by Google in Nature 638 (2025), our model predicts reductions in logical-error rates per unit time of up to 40%.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种现象学逻辑噪声模型，用于优化量子存储器中综合征测量的时序。研究分析表明，最优测量间隔与码距成反比，从而实现了逻辑错误率相对于固定间隔方案的指数级降低。此外，针对时变空闲噪声，作者开发了一种基于测量综合征活动性的自适应时序策略，该策略在短而强的噪声爆发下表现出显著优势。
authors: Tobias Haug, Kishor Bharti, Leandro Aolita

articles.title: Nonlinear Compton scattering in a quantized pump field
articles.title_zh: 量子化泵浦场中的非线性康普顿散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06289v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a fully quantized theory of nonlinear Compton scattering driven by a single-mode quantum field. Exact quantum-Volkov states retain pump depletion, back-action, and final-state correlations through displaced or squeezed-displaced Fock-state ladders. A finite Fock-state pump produces discrete photon-transfer edges and a terminal spectral cutoff. In the bright, weakly depleted regime, the exact theory reduces to a Wigner-function weighted-average of scattering probabilities evaluated at fixed complex field amplitudes, with ordinary and generalized Bessel functions describing the harmonic structure for circular and linear polarization, respectively. For squeezed coherent light, the squeezing angle controls the high-energy emission through photon-number fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了一种由单模量子场驱动的非线性康普顿散射的完全量子化理论。精确的量子-沃尔科夫态通过位移或压缩位移的福克态阶梯保留了泵浦耗尽、反作用和末态关联。研究表明，有限的福克态泵浦会产生离散的光子转移边缘和终端光谱截止。
authors: Kenan Qu

articles.title: On Optimal Quantum Data Hiding and Maximal Separable Ball
articles.title_zh: 关于最优量子数据隐藏和最大可分离球
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06308v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum data hiding asks how much distinguishing power can be lost when global measurements are restricted to local measurements and classical communication. In this work, we establish sharp results and improved bounds for several natural classes of restricted measurements. For bipartite systems on mathbb Cⁿøtimesmathbb C^m, we prove that the optimal data-hiding ratios against separable and LOCC measurements are both minn,m. This result follows from a stronger result that, for every 2łe płeinfty, the largest centered Schatten p-ball whose associated binary measurements are implementable by finite-round LOCC has radius minn,m²/p⁻¹. This strengthens the classic separable-ball theorems, while also providing an explicit finite-round LOCC implementation. For Alice-first one-way LOCC with Alice's local dimension equal to n, we prove that the optimal ratio is (1+o(1))n, with the upper bound obtained from a Gaussian rank-one POVM. For local operations without communication, we improve the universal upper bound to (πsqrt3/4+o(1))minn,m.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子数据隐藏问题，即当全局测量受限于局部测量和经典通信时，区分能力会损失多少。作者为几类受限测量建立了精确结果和改进的界限，证明了对于双分系统，对抗可分离和LOCC测量的最优数据隐藏比率均为minn,m。此外，研究还改进了无通信局部操作的普适上界。
authors: Zhi Li

articles.title: Bell nonlocality from twisted statistics
articles.title_zh: 来自扭曲统计的贝尔非局域性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06359v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate Bell correlations for a free real quantum scalar field on the noncommutative Moyal plane. Although the free field dynamics and the one-particle sector remain unchanged, the deformation enters through twisted multiparticle statistics and its Fock-space dressing representation. A classical external source coupled locally to the twist-dressed quantum field prepares coherent superpositions of momentum-pair configurations propagating toward two spacelike-separated laboratories. The momentum-dependent twist phases are generally nonfactorizable and generate entanglement between the corresponding wave-packet modes. We show that suitable local mode measurements lead to a violation of the CHSH Bell inequality. The resulting correlations provide an operational probe of the noncommutative structure encoded in the multiparticle sector of the quantum field.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非交换Moyal平面上自由实量子标量场的贝尔关联。研究发现，尽管自由场动力学和单粒子扇区保持不变，但形变通过扭曲的多粒子统计及其福克空间修饰表示引入。作者证明，适当的局部模式测量会导致CHSH贝尔不等式的违反，这些关联为探测量子场多粒子扇区中编码的非交换结构提供了操作性探针。
authors: Ivana DJ ordj ević, Jovan Potrebić, Aleksandra Gočanin, Dragoljub Gočanin

articles.title: Theory of Measurement-Altered Criticality
articles.title_zh: 测量改变的临界性理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05289v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Local measurements can alter long-range correlations in gapless quantum matter. We propose a theory of weakly-monitored Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids, a broad class of quantum critical states in one dimension. In order to address the intrinsic randomness of the measurement record, we develop a replica instanton calculation to study Born-averaged observables. We find that when measurements are relevant, average correlators of density and phase fluctuations decay at long distances as universal power laws with logarithmic corrections, a feature we argue is peculiar to measurement-induced randomness. We characterize the full multifractal spectrum of moments of correlations functions, revealing broad, strongly non-gaussian fluctuations across the ensemble of post-measurement states. We support these analytic results with matrix-product-state calculations, and provide a general picture of measurement-altered criticality for ground states described by 1+1d conformal field theories. Our results establish that physical measurements alter critical quantum states in a manner that lies beyond both forced measurements and conventional critical scaling.
articles.abstract_zh: 局部测量可以改变无能隙量子物质中的长程关联。本文提出了一个弱监测Tomonaga-Luttinger液体的理论，该理论通过复制瞬子计算研究了Born平均可观测量。研究发现，当测量相关时，密度和相位涨落的平均关联函数以带对数修正的普适幂律衰减，这表明测量诱导的随机性具有独特性。该工作还通过矩阵乘积态计算支持了分析结果，并为1+1维共形场理论描述的基态提供了测量改变临界性的通用图景。
authors: Kabir Khanna, Sara Murciano, Romain Vasseur

articles.title: Entangling power of neural networks
articles.title_zh: 神经网络的纠缠能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05293v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Characterizing the complexity of correlations between subsystems is a fundamental task across information theory, machine learning, and science. In quantum physics, neural networks have found increasing application in learning wavefunctions. Here we introduce the entangling power of an encoder-decoder neural network, which quantifies its ability to generate entanglement between subsystems, dependent on a latent space dimension K and the complexity class of the decoder. We exactly calculate this quantity for polynomial decoders of degree p acting on a K-dimensional latent space. Our results establish the exponential entangling power of neural networks with modest resources. More broadly, our work provides a framework for analyzing correlations in machine learning that generalizes the notion of the Schmidt rank in entanglement theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了编码器-解码器神经网络的纠缠能力，该能力量化了其在子系统之间生成纠缠的能力，并取决于潜在空间维度K和解码器的复杂性类别。研究精确计算了作用于K维潜在空间的p次多项式解码器的纠缠能力，结果表明神经网络以适度资源即可实现指数级的纠缠能力。这项工作为分析机器学习中的关联提供了一个框架，推广了纠缠理论中施密特秩的概念。
authors: Taige Wang, Nisarga Paul, Liang Fu

articles.title: Photon-nucleon entanglement in Compton scattering at low and high energies
articles.title_zh: 低能和高能康普顿散射中的光子-核子纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05330v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study spin-spin entanglement in the final state photon-nucleon system in Compton scattering, both at low energy below the pion threshold and at high energy in perturbative QCD to next-to-leading order. We first establish a no-go theorem showing that, for any spin-frac12 target, entanglement cannot be generated in unpolarized Compton scattering if the scattering amplitudes are real. We then consider polarized Compton scattering off the electron, the proton and the neutron. At low energy, we uncover a rich variety of maximally entangled Bell states and their unitary equivalents realized across different regions of the kinematic plane. Interestingly, the proton and neutron targets exhibit distinct patterns of entanglement. In the neutron case, the electric and magnetic polarizabilities dramatically influence the pattern and even the existence of entanglement. This suggests that entanglement can serve as a novel tool for investigating the detailed electromagnetic properties of the nucleons.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了康普顿散射中末态光子-核子系统的自旋-自旋纠缠，包括低能和高能情况。研究首先证明了一个“不可能定理”，指出在非极化康普顿散射中，如果散射振幅是实数，则无法产生纠缠。在低能下，质子和中子靶表现出不同的纠缠模式，其中中子的电极化率和磁极化率显著影响纠缠模式甚至其存在。这表明纠缠可以作为研究核子详细电磁性质的新工具。
authors: Yoshitaka Hatta, Víctor Martínez-Fernández

articles.title: Transparent boundary conditions for the spatially discrete Schrödinger equation: Reflectionless quantum transport in 1D lattices
articles.title_zh: 空间离散薛定谔方程的透明边界条件：一维晶格中的无反射量子传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05338v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct exact transparent boundary conditions (TBCs) for a time-continuous, spatially discrete Schrödinger equation that models a one-dimensional quantum lattice. Using a recently developed exact solution for the discrete system, we derive the Dirichlet-to-Neumann maps analytically via Laplace transforms. This yields a convolution-type boundary condition governed by Bessel functions. We rigorously demonstrate the consistency of this discrete formulation with its continuous counterpart in the continuum limit. Additionally, we present an efficient time-discretization scheme based on the trapezoidal rule for practical implementation. Numerical experiments using a Crank-Nicolson solver verify that our proposed TBCs eliminate spurious backscattering entirely and preserve reflectionless propagation of a Gaussian wave packet exiting the computational domain
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为模拟一维量子晶格的时间连续、空间离散薛定谔方程构建了精确的透明边界条件（TBCs）。通过拉普拉斯变换解析推导了狄利克雷-诺依曼映射，得到了由贝塞尔函数控制的卷积型边界条件。数值实验验证了所提出的TBCs完全消除了虚假反向散射，并保持了高斯波包在离开计算域时的无反射传播。该工作还严格证明了离散公式在连续极限下与连续对应物的自洽性，并提出了基于梯形法则的高效时间离散方案。
authors: Mashrab E. Akramov, Jambul R. Yusupov, Matthias Ehrhardt, Davron U. Matrasulov

articles.title: Diversity in Coded TE-QKD Channels: Achieving Infinite Diversity out of Finite System Resources
articles.title_zh: 编码时间纠缠量子密钥分发（TE-QKD）信道中的分集：从有限系统资源中实现无限分集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05432v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish conditions and give proofs on how an error-correcting code can attain infinite diversity in a time-entanglement quantum key distribution (TE-QKD) reconciliation. The shocking result, never encountered in the literature on coding and communication theory, is that a decoder exhibits an infinite diversity order while the channel has finite diversity and the code has a relatively short finite length. This paper studies the diversity order of coded TE-QKD reconciliation, defined by the asymptotic slope of the error probability at high signal-to-noise ratio. For bounded-distance algebraic decoding, we derive a necessary and sufficient condition in terms of the number of photons per codeword and the decoding radius. For soft-decision decoding, we introduce the maximal finite diversity (MFD) property and prove that infinite diversity is achieved if and only if the code is MFD deficient. The infinite diversity in TE-QKD has no counterpart in classical fading channels, where decoding can only multiply a finite diversity order by a finite factor. Examples of short codes based on Golay, Reed-Solomon, Bose-Chaudhuri-Hocquenghem (BCH), and Reed-Muller codes validate the analysis and illustrate how the TE-QKD system parameters and the relatively short code parameters affect the achievable diversity for both hard and soft information reconciliation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了纠错码如何在时间纠缠量子密钥分发（TE-QKD）协调中实现无限分集的条件并提供了证明。研究发现，解码器可以表现出无限的分集阶数，即使信道具有有限分集且码长相对较短。对于有界距离代数解码，推导了关于每个码字光子数和解码半径的充要条件。对于软判决解码，引入了最大有限分集（MFD）特性，并证明当且仅当码是MFD不足时才能实现无限分集。
authors: Shaikha S. Al-Qahtani, Siyao Li, Joseph J. Boutros

articles.title: Surviving correlations across a horizon: reflected entropy for bosonic fields in non-inertial frames and black hole spacetimes
articles.title_zh: 跨视界的幸存关联：非惯性系和黑洞时空中玻色子场的反射熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05473v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the reflected entropy and the Markov gap for modes of a free bosonic field shared by inertial observers (Alice, Charlie) and a uniformly accelerated one (Bob), for a bipartite Bell state and the tripartite Werner (W) and Greenberger--Horne--Zeilinger (GHZ) states. The bosonic Bogoliubov transformation spans an infinite-dimensional Fock space with an unbounded squeezing parameter unlike the fermionic case. By identifying a conserved charge, we block-diagonalize the reduced density matrices into exact two-dimensional sectors, yielding closed or semi-analytic forms for all three states. Although bosonic entanglement is known to vanish asymptotically, the Alice--Bob reflected entropy instead saturates at a nonzero saturation floor, retaining the surviving classical correlation, and converges to the value Alice shares with Bob's causally disconnected partner. Crucially, only the inter-wedge reflected entropy diverges, linearly in the squeezing parameter---the sharp distinction from the fermionic case, where it stays bounded---while the Markov gaps saturate. The construction transfers verbatim to a Schwarzschild black hole, where the saturation values become mass-independent constants.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了惯性观测者与匀加速观测者共享的自由玻色子场模式的反射熵和马尔可夫间隙。通过识别守恒电荷，将约化密度矩阵块对角化为精确的二维扇区，得到了所有三种状态的封闭或半解析形式。尽管玻色子纠缠渐近消失，但Alice-Bob反射熵却饱和在一个非零的饱和下限，保留了幸存的经典关联。该构造可直接应用于史瓦西黑洞时空。
authors: Sayid Mondal

articles.title: Entanglement Scaling and Full Counting Statistics in Excited States of Two-Dimensional Rotating Fermions
articles.title_zh: 二维旋转费米子激发态中的纠缠标度与全计数统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05722v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the entanglement entropy of a class of N-particle excited state of fermions confined in a two-dimensional harmonic trap rotating at an angular frequency Ømega. The excited state is constructed by filling a particular set of N single-particle energy levels. We analytically compute the Rényi entropies of order q in a disc of radius r around the centre of the trap, and the cumulants corresponding to number fluctuations of fermions within the disc. We found that the area law scaling of entanglement entropy holds even for a class of excited states. We also verified the well-known series expansion of entanglement entropy in terms of the particle number cumulants for non-interacting fermions. We further derive the centered cumulant generating function, demonstrating that the associated probability distribution function in the disc has identical scaling properties, up to a variable shift, to the known ground-state result. Finally, we extend our result to an annular region, showing that both the Rényi entropy and particle number cumulants of the annulus decompose into sums of the corresponding quantities of the two bounding discs. These additive relations hold as long as the width of the annulus is sufficiently large.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了限制在二维谐振阱中以角频率Ω旋转的N粒子费米子激发态的纠缠熵。研究分析计算了陷阱中心半径r的圆盘内的q阶Rényi熵以及费米子数涨落的累积量。结果表明，即使对于一类激发态，纠缠熵的面积定律标度仍然成立。该工作还推导了中心累积量生成函数，并将其结果推广到环形区域，表明环形的Rényi熵和粒子数累积量可以分解为两个边界圆盘相应量之和。
authors: Priyangshu Goswami, Abhishek Dhar, Satya N. Majumdar, Anupam Kundu

articles.title: Transverse quantum-state characterization of programmable electron optics
articles.title_zh: 可编程电子光学器件的横向量子态表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05749v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Programmable electron optics -- electronically controlled phase plates -- underpin proposals from dose-efficient phase imaging to shaped-electron X-ray sources, nearly all assuming a pure, fully coherent delivered wave whose purity has never been measured. Here we reconstruct the transverse density matrix of a microelectromechanical electrostatic spiral phase plate by mixed-state ptychography, from one four-dimensional STEM scan per state and without added hardware. The delivered beam is substantially mixed: its purity falls from approximately 0.47 to approximately 0.24 as the applied bias grows, inconsistent with a fixed lateral source-blur model, while the real-space coherence width stays near 1 nm. The same scans calibrate the device in situ, allow virtual orbital-angular-momentum sorting and, through a partial-coherence-aware transfer theory, indicate that purifying the output could improve dose efficiency roughly threefold. One acquisition thus becomes a quantum-state acceptance test for programmable electron optics, supplying the purity and coherence that emerging phase-plate and diffractive-imaging schemes assume but leave unquantified.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过混合态叠层衍射成像技术，重建了微机电静电螺旋相位板的横向密度矩阵。结果显示，输出电子束是显著混合的，其纯度随外加偏压的增加而下降，与固定横向源模糊模型不符。这些扫描还可以在原位校准器件，并表明净化输出可以使剂量效率提高约三倍。单次采集即可作为可编程电子光学器件的量子态验收测试，提供新兴相位板和衍射成像方案所假设但未测量的纯度和相干性。
authors: Shengbo You, Paolo Rosi, Enzo Rotunno, Alberto Roncaglia, Luca Belsito, Amir H. Tavabi, Rafal E. Dunin-Borkowski, Vincenzo Grillo, Philipp M. Pelz

articles.title: A Scale-Invariant Theory of the Universe
articles.title_zh: 宇宙的尺度不变理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05929v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern physics has achieved extraordinary empirical success while retaining much of the absolute, unobservable structure introduced by Newton, largely without questioning its necessity.
